Use case: ui-mockup. Produce a polished HIGH-FIDELITY RASTER DESIGN REVIEW BOARD for SIDEOUT, a Korean volleyball meetup web app. This is a proposed UI before implementation. Use the provided image ONLY as reference for navy typography, cool gray background, white cards, club identity marks, calm editorial information hierarchy; do not copy its excessive vertical space or old wording. Flat straight-on Figma-like screen exports, NO photoreal phones, no hands, no perspective. Beautiful and practical, not promotional. Crisp readable Korean using a modern Korean sans serif. Navy #234d76 primary, ink #172f45, cool background #f4f6fa, white cards, border #d7e2ec, muted #667b90, green #287957. Moderate 14px card corner radius, consistent thin line icons, compact spacing, 44px visual touch targets at a 390px mobile artboard scale. All screen content in Korean, exact copy given below. Club marks: N in blue/green circle for 뉴배동, H dark circle with gold detail for 히어로즈. Use subtle club accents, not bright filled whole cards. No gradients, glass or huge hero. No personal photos.
CRITICAL RULES across all screens: Do not use the words '함께할 인원' or '함께하는 회원' ANYWHERE. The roster trigger and roster dialog title are always '명단 확인' before and after publication. NO numerical milestone chips, threshold labels, target numbers or '명까지' labels on or beside the thin enrollment bar. In the home cards there are NO applicant/waiter counts outside the roster dialog: only '명단 확인' as the roster entry point with a thin green fill bar below it. Actual applicant and waiter counts may appear inside the roster modal and actual team totals may appear on the team page. The bar is a quiet unlabeled visual cue, not a completion/percentage label. App content stays unoccluded by floating menu. Add a small quiet white outlined '☰ 메뉴' capsule in an explicitly reserved bottom safe area, only on normal screens; hide it when a modal/sheet is open. Thin navy action buttons only for the main action.
Board header outside the screens: small 'SIDEOUT · 일정 화면 개선안'. Footer outside screens: '가상 데이터 · 구현 전 이미지 목업'. Very sharp and coherent. The output should be a large landscape board roughly 2048x1536 with the specified equal mobile artboards, enough resolution to inspect Korean text. Do not invent extra tabs, controls, badges, unread dots or numbers.
BOARD 1: THREE equally sized 390x844-like mobile screens aligned horizontally, with labels outside them '01 신청 중', '02 대기 등록', '03 공개 완료'. Each is the same HOME layout in three alternative states, not simultaneous conflicting sessions. Compact home top: small SIDEOUT wordmark left, title '운동 일정'. Week navigation in one row '10월 12–18일' left with previous arrow, '이번 주', next arrow right. Next row compact horizontal club chips '전체' selected dark navy, '즐겨찾기' star, '뉴배동' N, '히어로즈' H. Include a very compact 7-day date strip 월12 화13 수14 목15 금16 토17 일18 with event dots on weekend (no event-count text). The first primary card should start near 210px, not halfway down the screen.
All three main cards show 뉴배동, '내 모임', '10월 18일 일요일', map pin '양강초등학교 체육관', and a horizontal three-column time line '12:30 / 입장·몸풀기', '13:00 / 운동 시작', '17:00 / 종료'. Card title about20px at base scale. Roster row only '명단 확인' left with people icon and a right chevron on the right. Thin green fill bar directly under roster row. Primary action row separate from roster. A modest '운동 안내' text action with document icon is present in the card but does not compete with primary.
SCREEN1 card state small '접수 중', deadline '10.17 18:00 마감', thin bar filled90%, primary filled navy '참석 신청'. 
SCREEN2 small amber '대기 접수', supporting short '신청 마감', thin bar filled100%, main filled navy '대기 등록'. This is BEFORE publication.
SCREEN3 small green check '팀편성 공개', short neutral '참석 신청 완료', thin bar filled100%, full width prominent navy action '팀편성 · 경기 순서' with chevron. No disabled cancellation button.
Below each primary card show the beginning of a second 히어로즈 card (its mark, title, date and location) to establish list continuity and sensible density. The bottom menu capsule must be separated from cards by reserved breathing room. No upper hamburger button, no gigantic intro slogan. All information must fit realistically at mobile size without tiny text.

Within selected applicant tab, section label '소속 회원 12명', compact TWO-column name tile grid: 강현우, 김도윤, 남지안, 박지훈; each tile has compact neutral '취소' text button on right as operator control. SCREEN3 a bottom menu sheet opened by home floating menu, clean heading '메뉴' closeX. Only two primary destinations '운동 일정' with calendar icon and '계정 정보' with person icon, plus account summary at bottom '김나래 / 뉴배동'. No fabricated community features, notification feeds, settings toggles or direct logout action. The dimmed home behind shows the colorful filters and card. High polish compact readable spacing.
